title: (RHEA-2017:0485) Red Hat Gluster Storage 3.2.0
portal_summary: Updated glusterfs packages that fix several bugs and add various enhancements are now available for the Red Hat Common channel of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux for Scientific Computing|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Desktop|7|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Workstation|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
GlusterFS is a key building block of Red Hat Gluster Storage. It is based
on a stackable user-space design and can deliver exceptional performance
for diverse workloads. GlusterFS aggregates various storage servers over
network interconnections into one large, parallel network file system.

The glusterfs packages have been upgraded to ensure compatibility with the
updated Red Hat Gluster Storage 3.2. (BZ# 1377273)

Users of Red Hat Gluster Storage are advised to upgrade to these updated
packages, which fix these bugs and add these enhancements.
